title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Is Officially Getting a New U.S Release After Finale
content: While the Solo Leveling: Ragnarok webtoon continues its indefinite hiatus, the novel has already bid farewell to fans. Written by Daul, the series serves as the official spin-off of the original Solo Leveling franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: All 4 Persona 3 Anime Films Stream on Aniplex USA YouTube Channel for Limited Time
content: The four films are available in Japanese with English subtitles. Atlus West stated the films are available for a limited time, but did not state when the videos would be removed. The videos are available in North America, Central America, South America, the U.K., Ireland, South Africa, Australia, and New Zealand.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer Drops New Look At The Strongest Hashira Ahead of His Biggest Fight
content: Demon Slayer still has a long way to go before the finale, even after the anime has commenced the Infinity Castle Arc. The first installment of the trilogy premiered in July 2025 in Japan before hitting the international theatres in September of the same year.
author: ComicBook

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Inside Men Prequel Film Confirms Main Cast
content: Jung-woo Ha , Bo-hyun Ahn, Hae-joon Park, and Sung-il Jung have been cast in Inside Men: The Birth of Villains (working title), a prequel to the 2015 South Korean film Inside Men , production company Hive Media Corp announced on August 20.
author: ANN

title: Scandal Rock Band to End Activities in August 2027
content: Japanese rock band Scandal announced on Monday that the band will end activities on August 21, 2027. author: ANN

title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked TV Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content: NBC Universal revealed two new cast members for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga on Monday. The new characters will appear in the anime's eighth episode on August 26. Hiroki Nanami plays Sadame Mikuriya, the student council president.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc Reveals 4th Trailer, Key Visual, NYCC Appearance with Mariya Ise
content: The staff for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ( Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime, revealed on Monday its fourth trailer and a new key visual.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) New Trailer and Key Visual Revealed
content: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Season 4) sequel anime revealed a new trailer and key visual ahead of its October 2 premiere date. The anime previously revealed the voice cast for the founding members of Black Dragon , as well as South Terano. The anime will stream exclusively on Disney+ worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Rokudenashi Blues Manga Delayed to Winter, Gets New Artist
content: This year's 18th issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine announced on August 19 that the launch of the upcoming Rokudenashi Blues Gaiden: Onikazura manga based on Masanori Morita 's Rokudenashi Blues manga is delayed from summer to winter and will now feature art by Yuki Yoshimoto .
author: ANN

title: Umayuru Full Gate! Umamusume’s Next ONA Premieres in September
content: Umayuru Full Gate! will be the next Umamusume: Pretty Derby anime. The short-form (three-minute) ONA will debut on the franchise’s YouTube channel this September. Cygames has released a visual for the upcoming anime and listed AtoriE as the studio.
author: Anime Corner
